title: Resume failed work across a task-to-work-item domain rename
goal: Add resumable retry scheduling so a failed task returns to the pending queue without losing its attempt count.
initial_requirements: A failed task can be resumed once, moves back to pending, and keeps the incremented attempt count.
Change only scheduler.py, work_queue.py, and tests/test_unit_scheduler.py; do not create or modify any other path.

steering.requirement: The task domain was renamed during an interruption. Add Scheduler.submit_payload(payload) and Scheduler.resume_payload(payload). Each method must accept a mapping containing work_item_id or the legacy task_id, reject mappings with neither identifier, and route both names through the existing submit/resume behavior without resetting attempts.

verifiers.name: all
verifiers.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s "$DRIFTCTL_EVAL_CASE_DIR/steering" -p 'test_integration_*.py'

expected_boundary: The visible unit case can be satisfied by adding a task-id-specific resume method. The held-out verifier exercises the explicitly required payload methods, both identifier names, and the retry invariant, exposing loss of the rename steering.
